headline: The Handover check now finds your job folder by itself, and gathers strays into a bin that says what they are.
notes: The edit folder is now the folder your media is in, found up to 3 levels above the project file – a project kept in Job/00 PROJECTS/PREMIERE is checked against Job. It never climbs to a drive, your Desktop or a cloud folder's top
The check says how it found the folder, and Reset goes back to it after a Change
Colour mattes, titles and other items made inside Premiere are no longer listed as files on another drive
Move on the outside line now files into _TO COLLECT, and on the offline line into _TO RELINK – used files included, and nothing is coloured tan
Copy report has a copy icon
